svg.title: Divers' Yard — Diving gantry & gong
svg.desc: Six dry training stations surround a shallow drill basin. Tethered pontoons, rope ladders and a high gong deck offer a playful route without a swimming prerequisite. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Six dry training stations surround a shallow drill basin. Tethered pontoons, rope ladders
and a high gong deck offer a playful route without a swimming prerequisite.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
